attributes.name: content
attributes.value: A high-quality, unstyled React toast component to generate notifications.

children.value: Import the component and assemble its parts:

import { Toast } from 'baseui-solid2/toast';

<Toast.Provider>
  <Toast.Portal>
    <Toast.Viewport>
      {/* Stacked toasts */}
      <Toast.Root>
        <Toast.Content>
          <Toast.Title />
          <Toast.Description />
          <Toast.Action />
          <Toast.Close />
        </Toast.Content>
      </Toast.Root>

      {/* Anchored toasts */}
      <Toast.Positioner>
        <Toast.Root>
          <Toast.Arrow />
          <Toast.Content>
            <Toast.Title />
            <Toast.Description />
            <Toast.Action />
            <Toast.Close />
          </Toast.Content>
        </Toast.Root>
      </Toast.Positioner>
    </Toast.Viewport>
  </Toast.Portal>
</Toast.Provider>;

data.sourceValue:
import { Toast } from '@base-ui/react/toast';

<Toast.Provider>
  <Toast.Portal>
    <Toast.Viewport>
      {/* Stacked toasts */}
      <Toast.Root>
        <Toast.Content>
          <Toast.Title />
          <Toast.Description />
          <Toast.Action />
          <Toast.Close />
        </Toast.Content>
      </Toast.Root>

      {/* Anchored toasts */}
      <Toast.Positioner>
        <Toast.Root>
          <Toast.Arrow />
          <Toast.Content>
            <Toast.Title />
            <Toast.Description />
            <Toast.Action />
            <Toast.Close />
          </Toast.Content>
        </Toast.Root>
      </Toast.Positioner>
    </Toast.Viewport>
  </Toast.Portal>
</Toast.Provider>;
